dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Anterior margin rises at an angle of approximately 55 degrees relative to the horizontal dorsal body axis.

other_distinctive_markers: The skin displays a highly complex mottled pigmentation pattern with irregular light and dark gray patches.
